control_descriptions.naive_first_record: Customer: the reference at claim and confirmation; at disclosure reveals exactly the requested IDs, each valued from the flat private_facts map or else the first listed record for that fact, ignoring document, revision and revocation.
control_descriptions.naive_first_sorted: Intake: requests the first min(3, n) undisclosed available fact IDs in sorted order, ignoring the routing plan and collection contract.
control_descriptions.naive_full_refund: Policy, first turn: submits a full refund (eligible, full_refund, execute_refund, item_net_price + allocated_tax, original_payment, execute, seller) citing the first public full-refund rule ID, without collecting a fact.
control_descriptions.naive_no_mutation: Payments: always no_mutation with amount 0, method none and no allocations, echoing proposal, idempotency and snapshot IDs; never reads the ledger amounts.
control_descriptions.naive_overdisclose: Customer: the reference at claim and confirmation; at disclosure reveals every private fact it holds instead of the requested ones.
control_descriptions.noop_null_resolution: Policy, first turn: submits the null resolution (unresolved, no remedy, no_mutation, amount 0, no payment, payer none, rule NO_DECISION) without collecting a fact.
control_descriptions.random_legal: Policy, seeded: requests a uniformly random nonempty subset (at most 3) of the facts the public branch specification lists as pending; once none are pending, submits a uniformly random canonical resolution (amount from {0, item_net_price, item_net_price + allocated_tax}, rule ID from the public catalogue, reason_code = policy_basis) that satisfies the environment's legality guard. Draws are keyed by seed and the canonical observation.
control_descriptions.refuse_empty: Returns an empty JSON object on every turn: no decision at all.
